title: Conditions of Sale for Air Ticket Fare Brands: Entry and Journey Length
content:
1. Application. These conditions govern the sale of air tickets under Air Ticket Fare Brands and fix, for each of the seven fare brands, the advance purchase required for the brand to be sold, the minimum number of nights that must fall between outbound and return, the maximum number of calendar days by which the return may fall after the outbound departure, and the number of calendar months for which the ticket stays valid for travel from the date of issue.

2. Defined quantities. The quantities referred to in these conditions are those stated in the schedule below.

| Quantity | Basic Economy Lite | Economy Saver | Economy Classic | Economy Flex | Premium Economy Select | Business Saver | Business Flex |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Advance purchase, calendar days between booking and departure | 21 | 14 | 7 | 3 | 3 | 1 | 0 |
| Minimum stay, nights between outbound and return | 3 | 2 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Maximum stay, calendar days the return may fall after outbound departure | 30 | 90 | 180 | 330 | 330 | 330 | 365 |
| Ticket validity from date of issue, calendar months | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |

3. Advance purchase. A fare brand may be sold only where the calendar days between the date of booking and the date of departure are at least the number stated for that brand in the schedule.

   3.1 A booking made 21 calendar days before departure satisfies the condition for Basic Economy Lite; a booking made 20 calendar days before departure does not.

   3.2 Business Flex states 0 calendar days and is accordingly open on the day of departure itself; Business Saver requires 1 day, and Economy Flex and Premium Economy Select alike require 3.

4. Minimum stay. The nights falling between the outbound and the return must be at least the number stated. A stay of 2 nights satisfies Economy Saver and does not satisfy the 3 nights of Basic Economy Lite. Where the number stated is 0, as it is for Economy Flex, Premium Economy Select, Business Saver and Business Flex, no minimum stay is required.

5. Maximum stay. The return may fall no more than the stated number of calendar days after the outbound departure. Under Economy Saver a return falling on the 90th day after outbound departure is within the condition and a return falling on the 91st day is not; the same reading gives 30 days under Basic Economy Lite, 180 under Economy Classic, 330 under each of Economy Flex, Premium Economy Select and Business Saver, and 365 under Business Flex.

6. Validity. A ticket stays valid for travel for 12 calendar months from the date of issue, and that period of 12 months is the same under all seven brands.
